observations: REQUIRED ORCHESTRATOR ACTION (non-blocking for the contract text, blocking for Loop 2 if ignored) -- S3 reviewer-evidence trap. This review's own evidence was written, as instructed, under .agent/evidence/099-qa-adversarial-contract-review/. That directory is NOT in S3's owned_prefixes (.agent/validator/099, .agent/qa/099, .agent/evidence/099-qa-adversarial, .agent/evidence/099/qa/, .agent/evidence/099/failed-attempt) and is not in scope.files_create. Reproduced in scratch (evidence 05-s3-reviewer-evidence-trap.txt): with any file under that directory present, S3 prints 'extra: [.agent/evidence/099-qa-adversarial-contract-review/...]' and exits 1. It trips whether the files are committed into <B> (visible via git diff --name-only 483f016 inside the attempt worktree) or left untracked in the shared tree (visible via git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all on the promoted tree the Evaluator re-checks). The .agent/qa/099-contract-review.json verdict and .agent/validator/099-mode-a.json are safe (they match the .agent/qa/099 and .agent/validator/099 prefixes). Fix without reopening the contract (the final permitted revision is already spent): BEFORE committing <B>, relocate the directory to an allowlisted prefix, e.g. `mv .agent/evidence/099/contract-review .agent/evidence/099-qa-adversarial-contract-review`, and cite the new path wherever this review is referenced. The alternative, adding '.agent/evidence/099-qa-adversarial-contract-review/' to S3's owned_prefixes, is a contract edit and needs a 4th revision.

AT1-AT8 are byte-identical to .agent/feature_list_014.json feature 099 acceptance_tests[0..7]: for all 8, acceptance_test == command == feature-list string, and acceptance_test_index matches the 1-based position (evidence 01-at-byte-identity.txt, programmatic, EXIT:0).

Base states reproduced in a scratch clone at 483f016 plus the contract file (evidence 02-base-red-states.txt): AT2 green (regression guard by design); AT3, AT4, AT5, AT6, AT7 red (exit 1); S7, S8, S9, S10, S11, S12 red for the intended reasons (messages inspected: no Section-1 rows / pinned paragraph absent / versions unbumped / 0.3.0->0.3.0 18->18 / 33->33 / docs_updated missing / guide Key-documents unchanged), not by exception; S1, S3, S4 green at base (S1 and S4 guards; S3 is a boundary check, green on an untouched tree by design).

Positive control (evidence 03-positive-control.txt): the contract's pinned edits were applied minimally in a scratch copy -- 06/08 status active, version 0.2.0, head change_log entry, exactly the pinned phrase deleted (wrapped across a line break, reflowed); the two capability entries added to NIZAM.json and tools/skill.json (0.3.0 -> 0.4.0); only the guide card's Key documents paragraph re-synced to README plus 00-08; both gate rows moved into Section 1 as single physical lines, Section 2 reduced to the pinned paragraph with verbatim heading; ecosystem/README.md 0.5.0; CHANGELOG entry; phase_014.yaml step 099 gains docs_updated/changelog_entry/evidence only. Result: all 20 verification entries exit 0 -- AT1 (GATE: PASS, 16 checks, baseline 16), AT2-AT7, AT8 (SELF-TEST OK 79/79, 0 failed), S1-S12 including S2, S5 (19 tags, none new) and S6. The same edits repeated inside a detached git worktree whose HEAD is a commit <B> containing the contract and Mode A verdict (HEAD != 483f016), then after committing the deliverable plus evidence in that worktree (the attempt commit), also pass every entry; S3 is therefore not vacuous after a commit and the 483f016 anchors in S3/S4/S7-S12 hold when HEAD moves. The simulation is approximate in prose only (summary wording, row wording); every structural pin is exact.

Negative controls (evidence 04-negative-controls.txt) -- every required defect makes the targeted check FAIL with exit 1: re-added Section 2 table row (H-GA and H-CONSOLIDATION variants) -> AT5 and S7; only one of the two gates defined (each variant) -> AT5 and S7; Section-1 rows saying RESERVED not DEFINED -> AT5 and S7; row claiming EXERCISED, unpinned or extended Section 2 paragraph, changed Section 2 heading -> S7; 06 body line added, phrase left in place, 08 body word swapped -> S7; second edited paragraph in the guide card, an edit in another card -> S12; guide card missing 08, nested article, unchanged guide -> AT7; status flip on a feature other than 099, top-level feature_list edit, 099 acceptance_tests edit, invalid 099 status, reordered features, extra out-of-scope file, ROADMAP edit -> S3; missing change_log bump on 06, change_log head not equal to version on operator_gates, ecosystem/README.md not bumped, 08 left at 0.1.0 -> S8 (08 and 06-not-active also AT6); README retaining either 'reserved' phrase or 'proposal-grade (status `draft`)' -> S8; one skill.json capability, skill version unbumped, extra skill key -> AT4/S9; one NIZAM capability, framework.version bumped, key_documents edited, wrong authoritative_source -> AT3/S10; phase step 100 edit, step 099 missing docs_updated, step 099 BLOCKED -> S11; frozen-infra or .github edit -> S4; contract schema break -> S1. Hazard literals in the new operator_gates change_log ('## 1. Decided and active gates' or '## 2. Reserved') make AT5 and S7 fail closed; a '---' sequence in a 06 change_log summary makes AT6 and S7 fail. Positive-direction controls pass as they must: a legitimate 099 status flip in feature_list_014.json (S3 = 0) and step 099 COMPLETED (S11 = 0, status excluded by design).

Discrimination notes (none is a defect). (1) The first 08 body-edit mutation exited 0 on S7 because the sentence also appears in 08's frontmatter description and the replace hit that copy; S7(c) is body-scoped by design and the re-run with true body edits exited 1. (2) AT1 stays green when a governed document's change_log bump is missing or mismatched, because validate.sh C8 also accepts a root CHANGELOG.md line naming the path and the 099 CHANGELOG entry supplies that; S8, anchored to 483f016 and asserting version strictly above base and head change_log == version, is the sole discriminator and is sound. The contract's hazard text that C8 'demands a change_log entry' slightly overstates C8 but S8 does not rely on it. (3) S12 stays 0 when the card omits 08; that is S12's scope-only job, AT7 owns content.

Testability from an attempt worktree at <B> (evidence 03, worktree section): every command is root-relative and was run with the worktree root as cwd; nothing depends on the shell's prior cwd or on files outside the tree. They need the 483f016 object (present, worktrees share the object store) and python3 with yaml and jsonschema (present). <B> containing the committed contract is what S1 and S3 need and is handled correctly: contracts/099.json, validator/099-mode-a.json and the future qa/099 files are all on the S3 allowlist (see the first observation for the one exception). Timing: AT1 about 10 s, AT8 about 15 s, the whole set about 45 s, no sleeps, no timing assertions; AT1 and AT8 must stay sequential. Network: only S5 (`git fetch --tags --quiet origin`, origin = GitHub) is network-dependent; it fails closed offline (documented in phase_tag_check.py) and mutates only local tag refs, so an offline Generator would see S5 red for an environmental reason; it is a phase-level acceptance copied from the spec and not a 099 deliverable check. validate.sh C8 compares against HEAD, which in the attempt root is <B> and after the attempt commit is the deliverable itself; C8 is then trivially satisfied, so the final AT1 capture is sound but S8 (483f016 anchor) is the check that carries the version/change_log obligation. Evidence line 1 for the heredoc entries (S1, S3, S7-S12) is a multi-line invocation; the capture wrapper must record the full command text, which the contract's evidence_convention already requires.

Section 10 review. (a) whole-file: AT5/AT6 split on literals and S8's README phrase scan reads the whole file including frontmatter; verified at base that each of the three README phrases occurs once, in the body, so the positive control passes, but a new 0.5.0 change_log summary containing 'reserved `H-GA`', 'reserved `H-CONSOLIDATION`' or 'proposal-grade (status `draft`)' makes S8 fail (probe in evidence 04). The Generator must avoid those three literals in that summary; fail-closed, not a vacuous pass. The S7(a) check tests DEFINED/OUTSTANDING across the whole row rather than the Disposition cell, so a stray 'DEFINED' in another cell could satisfy it; the disposition-cell EXERCISED/SATISFIED scan and the Introduced/semantics requirement limit the exposure, and AT5 itself has the same shape; low severity. (b) git diff HEAD blindness: S3 unions git diff --name-only 483f016 with git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all, verified to see an untracked file and a committed file. (c) bare adjacency: none; row, section, paragraph and frontmatter checks are anchored to parsed structure. (d) literal substring: AT6 uses parsed YAML; S8 uses tuple version comparison; S12 uses a fixed anchor with a single-occurrence assert. (e) exit codes: no command pipes a tool into grep/tail/awk; AT8 uses `; test $? -eq 0` after the tool; S5 uses `&&`; the heredoc checks exit via sys.exit; S3 and S7-S12 use subprocess check=True so a git failure is a non-zero traceback, not a pass. No vacuous pass found: every AT3-AT7 and S7-S12 flips red to green on the positive control.

Residual non-blocking edges: a Section-1 row missing its trailing pipe still satisfies AT5 and S7 (GFM tolerates it; no AT requires the pipe); S3 treats the three feature_list_014.json checks only if the file appears in the changed set, which is correct. ROADMAP.md lines ~216, 242 and 466 and the CONTEXT.md and manifest.json phase-014 notes still describe 06/08 as draft and the gates as reserved; the contract defers them to feature 102's refresh (non_goals) and I confirmed by grep that no shipped, validator-swept document other than the ones 099 edits makes that claim in its body. The Generator rework note from Mode A stands: revert a promoted attempt commit before cherry-picking a rework.

final_verdict.summary: APPROVED at revision 2 (099-contract attempt 3/3), conditional on one Orchestrator housekeeping action that needs no contract edit: relocate this review's evidence directory out of .agent/evidence/099-qa-adversarial-contract-review/ to an S3-allowlisted prefix before committing <B>, otherwise S3 exits 1 in Loop 2 (reproduced). AT1-AT8 are byte-identical to feature_list_014.json feature 099. Controls that were never executed were executed in scratch state: base red states reproduced (AT3-AT7 and S7-S12 red for the intended reasons, AT2/S1/S3/S4 green by design); a minimal pinned-edits end state turns all 20 verification entries green, including AT1 (16/16), AT8 (79/79), S2, S5, S6, and stays green inside a detached worktree at a commit <B> before and after the attempt commit; 40+ negative mutations (re-added Section 2 row, 06 body edit, second guide paragraph, other-feature status flip, top-level feature_list edit, single gate defined, missing change_log bump, and more) each fail the targeted check, with two legitimate-flip controls passing. Commands are cwd-root-relative, deterministic and fast (about 45 s total); the only network dependence is S5, which fails closed. No pipeline-swallowed exits, vacuous passes or unscoped whole-file greps that can pass wrongly were found; the S8 README scan is whole-file but only in the fail-closed direction.
